column2: This is a report containing details about all the issues affecting the items in your data feed. This report contains two tabs:

This tab contains details of all the issues affecting the items in your data feed. These issues may either block the item from uploading to your catalog, or affect how these items show in Shops or ads. Here is a brief explanation of each of the columns in the report:

column3: The content ID of the item
The exact line number of that particular item in your data feed.
The consequence as a result of the issue affecting the item. For example, 'Not uploaded' or 'Not showing in ads'.
The exact issue affecting the item.
A more detailed description of the issue affecting the item.
Instructions on how to fix the issue including any helpful links to our Help Center.

column2: When an item in your catalog is affected by an issue, it might result in them not being uploaded to your catalog, or not showing in Shops or ads. Here is a breakdown of the values in the 'Results' column in the Issue report tab.

column3: Items hasn't been uploaded to your catalog.
Item won't show in your shop, and people can't see or buy it.
Item won't show in your ads, and people can't see it.

column2: Not showing in Shops and ads
column3: Item won't show in your ads, and people can't see it.
Troubleshoot items not showing in Shops or ads

column2: This tab contains a breakdown of all the recommendations regarding the items in your catalog. Recommendations don't block your items from being uploaded, or from showing in Shops and ads, but are suggestions made by Meta to improve the quality of your items.

column3: The content ID of the item
The exact line number of that particular item in your data feed.
The exact recommendation for the item.
A more detailed description of the recommendation for the item.
